# Dictionnaire des colonnes attendues pour chaque table
colonnes_attendues = {
    "orders": ["order_id", "customer_id", "order_date", "status", "total_amount", "shipping_address_id", "promotion_id"],
    "customers": ["customer_id", "first_name", "last_name", "email", "phone", "gender", "birth_date", "registration_date", "tier", "newsletter"],
    "products": ["product_id", "product_name", "category_id", "supplier_id", "brand", "price", "cost_price", "weight_kg", "sku", "barcode", "created_at", "is_active"],
    "categories": ["category_id", "category_name", "parent_category", "description", "created_at"],
    "suppliers": ["supplier_id", "supplier_name", "contact_name", "email", "phone", "country", "rating", "created_at"],
    "warehouses": ["warehouse_id", "warehouse_name", "city", "address", "capacity", "manager_name", "opened_date"],
    "customer_addresses": ["address_id", "customer_id", "address_type", "street", "city", "postal_code", "country", "is_default"],
    "promotions": ["promotion_id", "promo_code", "description", "discount_pct", "start_date", "end_date", "min_purchase", "is_active"],
    "shipments": ["shipment_id", "order_id", "carrier", "tracking_number", "ship_date", "delivery_date", "shipping_cost", "status"],
    "order_items": ["order_item_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "unit_price", "discount_applied"],
    "returns": ["return_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "return_reason", "return_date", "refund_amount", "status"],
    "reviews": ["review_id", "customer_id", "product_id", "rating", "review_text", "review_date", "is_verified"],
    "inventory": ["inventory_id", "product_id", "warehouse_id", "quantity", "reorder_level", "last_restock_date", "unit_cost"],
    "loyalty_points": ["loyalty_id", "customer_id", "points_earned", "points_redeemed", "transaction_date", "points_type"],
    "payments": ["payment_id", "order_id", "payment_date", "payment_method", "amount", "status"]
}

def lire_toutes_les_tables():
    tables = {}
    erreurs = []
    
    for table_name, cols in colonnes_attendues.items():
        path = f"abfss://raw@adlsbougrine.dfs.core.windows.net/{table_name}/{table_name}.csv"
        df, success, message = read_csv_safe(path, table_name, expected_columns=cols)
        print(message)
        
        if success:
            tables[table_name] = df
        else:
            erreurs.append((table_name, message))
    
    return tables, erreurs

# Exécution
tables_chargees, erreurs_chargement = lire_toutes_les_tables()

print(f"Tables chargées avec succès : {len(tables_chargees)}/{len(colonnes_attendues)}")
if erreurs_chargement:
    print(f"⚠️ {len(erreurs_chargement)} erreur(s) rencontrée(s) :")
    for table, msg in erreurs_chargement:
        print(f"  - {msg}")

print("Nombre de cœurs disponibles :", spark.sparkContext.defaultParallelism)
print()

for nom, df in tables_chargees.items():
    nb_partitions_actuelles = df.rdd.getNumPartitions()
    nb_lignes = df.count()
    print(f"{nom}: {nb_partitions_actuelles} partitions actuelles, {nb_lignes} lignes")

# Vérification qu'aucune table critique n'a échoué
if erreurs_chargement:
    raise Exception(f"🛑 Pipeline arrêté : {len(erreurs_chargement)} tables n'ont pas pu être chargées correctement.")

# Tables à repartitionner 
df_customers = tables_chargees["customers"].repartition(8)
df_addresses = tables_chargees["customer_addresses"].repartition(8)
df_payments = tables_chargees["payments"].repartition(8)
df_shipments = tables_chargees["shipments"].repartition(8)
df_reviews = tables_chargees["reviews"].repartition(8)
df_loyalty_points = tables_chargees["loyalty_points"].repartition(8)
df_inventory = tables_chargees["inventory"].repartition(8)

# Tables déjà correctement partitionnées - pas de changement
df_orders = tables_chargees["orders"]
df_items = tables_chargees["order_items"]

# Tables trop petites - pas de changement
df_products = tables_chargees["products"]
df_categories = tables_chargees["categories"]
df_suppliers = tables_chargees["suppliers"]
df_warehouses = tables_chargees["warehouses"]
df_promotions = tables_chargees["promotions"]
df_returns = tables_chargees["returns"]

#Nombre de valeurs nulls pour chaque colonne
from pyspark.sql.functions import count,col,when,trim,lower
df_orders.select([count(when(col(c).isNull(),c)).alias(c)
for c in df_orders.columns]).show()

#Nettoyage des statuts
invalid_status = ["unk","other","n/a","unknown","null","none","???","-1"]
df_orders_clean = df_orders.withColumn(
    "status",
    when(
        trim(lower(col("status"))).isin(invalid_status) | col("status").isNull(), "inconnu"
    ).otherwise(col("status"))
)
print("Status après nettoyage\n")
df_orders_clean.groupBy("status").count().orderBy("count", ascending=False).show()

#Suppression des doublons
print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication : {df_orders.count()}")
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.dropDuplicates(["order_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication : {df_orders_clean.count()}")

from pyspark.sql.functions import percentile_approx,abs,coalesce,lit
df_orders_clean.select(
    percentile_approx("total_amount", 0.25).alias("Q1"),
    percentile_approx("total_amount", 0.50).alias("Médiane"),
    percentile_approx("total_amount", 0.75).alias("Q3"),
    percentile_approx("total_amount", 0.95).alias("P95"),
    percentile_approx("total_amount", 0.99).alias("P99")
).show()

#Nettoyage des montants 
#Supprimer montant négatifs pour statuts actifs et >10000
statuts_actifs = ["Livrée","En cours","En attente","Expédiée"]
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.filter(
    ~(col("status").isin(statuts_actifs) & (col("total_amount")<0))
)
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.filter(
    ~(col("total_amount")>10000)
)
#valeurs absolues pour remboursée et annulée et inconnu
statuts_remb = ["Remboursée","Annulée","inconnu"]
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.withColumn(
    "total_amount",when(
        (col("total_amount")<0) & col("status").isin(statuts_remb),abs(col("total_amount"))
    ).otherwise(col("total_amount"))
)

#médiane pour montants nulls
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.withColumn(
    "total_amount",coalesce(col("total_amount"),lit(55.51))

#Vérification des formats de dates
from pyspark.sql.functions import to_timestamp, col,regexp_replace,concat,substring

#convertir order_date au format standard
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.withColumn(
    "order_date_parsed",
    to_timestamp(col("order_date"), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
)

nb_invalides = df_orders_clean.filter(col("order_date_parsed").isNull()).count()
print(f"Lignes avec format de date non standard : {nb_invalides}")

#dates "problématiques"
df_orders_clean.filter(col("order_date_parsed").isNull()).select("order_date").show(20, truncate=False)
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.drop("order_date_parsed")

#Nettoyage des formats de dates
df_orders_clean = df_orders_clean.withColumn("order_date_str",col("order_date").cast("string"))\
    .withColumn("order_date_clean", regexp_replace(col("order_date_str"),"[/.]","-"))\
    .withColumn("order_date_clean",
        when(col("order_date_clean").rlike(r'^\d{8}'),
            concat(
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),1,4),lit("-"),
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),5,2),lit("-"),
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),7,2)
            )
        ).otherwise(col("order_date_clean"))
    )\
    .withColumn("order_date_clean",
        when(
            col("order_date_clean").rlike(r'^\d{2}-\d{2}.*\d{4}$'),
            concat(
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),-4,4),lit("-"),
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),1,2),lit("-"),
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),4,2),  
                substring(col("order_date_clean"),6,9),              
            )
        ).otherwise(col("order_date_clean"))
    )\
    .withColumn("order_date",to_timestamp(col("order_date_clean")))\
    .drop("order_date_clean","order_date_str")

null_dates = df_orders_clean.filter(col("order_date").isNull()).count()
print(f"Dates NULL après correction : {null_dates}")
print(f"lignes totales de dataset orders: {df_orders_clean.count()}")

#nombre de lignes nulls
from pyspark.sql.functions import count, col, when,coalesce, lit, trim,lower,length,concat,regexp_replace
df_customers.select([count(when(col(c).isNull(),c)).alias(c)
for c in df_customers.columns]).show()
#nettoyage des nulls de la colonne tier
#vérififcation des valeurs dans la colonne gender

#nettoyage des valeurs manquantes et invalides de la colonne gender
invalid_gender = ["unk","unknown","other","null","none","n/a","???","-1"]
df_customers_clean = df_customers_clean.withColumn("gender", when(col("gender")=="Other","Other")
    .when(trim(lower(col("gender"))).isin(invalid_gender) | col("gender").isNull(),"inconnu")
    .otherwise(col("gender")))

#correction des numéros incorrects
df_customers_clean = df_customers_clean\
    .withColumn("phone",
        when(
            length(col("phone"))==13,concat(lit("0"),regexp_replace(col("phone"),r"^(0033|\+33\s?)",""))
        ).otherwise(col("phone"))

#nettoyage des doublons
print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication: {df_customers_clean.count()}")
df_customers_clean = df_customers_clean.dropDuplicates(["customer_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication: {df_customers_clean.count()}")

#nettoayge des emails (remplacement de _ par @)
df_customers_clean = df_customers_clean.withColumn(
    "email",regexp_replace(col("email"),"_","@")

from pyspark.sql.functions import split, col

df_customers_clean.withColumn("domain", split(col("email"), "@").getItem(1)) \
    .groupBy("domain").count().orderBy("count", ascending=False).show()

#nettoyage des doublons
print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication : {df_products.count()}")
df_products_clean = df_products.dropDuplicates(["product_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication : {df_products_clean.count()}")

#remplacer les SKU nulls par des sku générés
from pyspark.sql.functions import lpad,concat,lit
df_products_clean = df_products_clean.withColumn(
    "sku",
    when(
        col("sku").isNull(),
        concat(lit("SKU-"), lpad(col("product_id").cast("string"), 6, "0"))
    ).otherwise(col("sku"))
)

#Vérification des doublons dans SKU
print(f"SKUs distincts : {df_products_clean.dropDuplicates(['sku']).count()}")
print(f"Total lignes : {df_products_clean.count()}")

#quartiles et percentiles de poids
print(f"Poids négatifs : {df_products_clean.filter(col('weight_kg') < 0).count()}")
df_products_clean.select(
    percentile_approx("weight_kg", 0.25).alias("Q1"),
    percentile_approx("weight_kg",0.5).alias("médiane"),
    percentile_approx("weight_kg",0.75).alias("Q3"),
    percentile_approx("weight_kg",0.99).alias("P99"),
).show()

#valeur absolue pour les valeurs négatifs et suppression des poids aberrantes
df_products_clean = df_products_clean.withColumn("weight_kg",when(col("weight_kg")<0,abs(col("weight_kg")))\
    .otherwise(col("weight_kg")))
df_products_clean = df_products_clean.filter(col("weight_kg")<=100)

#suppression des doublons
print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication : {df_categories.count()}")
df_categories_clean = df_categories.dropDuplicates(["category_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication : {df_categories_clean.count()}")

print(f"lignes totales avant déduplication : {df_suppliers.count()}")
df_suppliers_clean = df_suppliers.dropDuplicates(["supplier_id"])
print(f"lignes totales après déduplication : {df_suppliers_clean.count()}")

#nettoyage des pays manquantes et invalides
invalid_country = ["unk","other","n/a","unknown","null","none","???","-1"]
df_suppliers_clean = df_suppliers_clean.withColumn("country",
    when(
        trim(lower(col("country"))).isin(invalid_country) | col("country").isNull(),"Inconnu"
    ).otherwise(col("country"))

#nettoyage des numéros invalides
df_suppliers_clean = df_suppliers_clean\
    .withColumn("phone",
        when(length(col("phone")) == 13,
            concat(lit(0),regexp_replace(col("phone"),r"^(0033|\+33\s?)",""))).otherwise(col("phone")))
#remplacement des notes nulls par le mode (4)

#Remplacement des villes manquantes
df_warehouses_clean = df_warehouses.withColumn("city",when(
    col("city").isNull(),"inconnu"
).otherwise(col("city")))

#suppression des doublons
print(f"lignes totales avant déduplication : {df_warehouses.count()}")
df_warehouses_clean = df_warehouses_clean.dropDuplicates(["warehouse_id"])
print(f"lignes totales après déduplication : {df_warehouses_clean.count()}")

#suppression des espaces
df_warehouses_clean = df_warehouses_clean\
    .withColumn("warehouse_name", trim(col("warehouse_name")))\
    .withColumn("city", trim(col("city")))\
    .withColumn("address", trim(col("address")))\
    .withColumn("manager_name", trim(col("manager_name")))

print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication : {df_addresses.count()}")
df_addresses_clean = df_addresses.dropDuplicates(["address_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication : {df_addresses_clean.count()}")

#nettoyage des pays invalides
invalid_country = ["unk","other","n/a","unknown","null","none","???","-1"]
df_addresses_clean = df_addresses_clean\
    .withColumn("country",
        when((trim(lower(col("country"))).isin(invalid_country)) | (col("country").isNull()),"France")\
            .otherwise(col("country")
        )

#remplacement des codes postaux invalides par inconnu
df_addresses_clean = df_addresses_clean.withColumn("postal_code",when(
    (length(col("postal_code")) == 3) | (length(col("postal_code")) == 7) | (col("postal_code").isNull()),"inconnu").otherwise(col("postal_code"))

# on garde TOUTES les adresses du client, on corrige juste is_default
window = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("address_id")

df_addresses_clean = df_addresses_clean.withColumn(
    "rang_default",
    when(col("is_default") == True, row_number().over(window))
)

df_addresses_clean = df_addresses_clean.withColumn(
    "is_default",
    when(col("rang_default") == 1, True).otherwise(False)
).drop("rang_default")

from pyspark.sql import Window
from pyspark.sql.functions import row_number, desc, when, col, max as spark_max

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(desc("is_default"), col("address_id"))

window_client = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")

df_addresses_clean = df_addresses_clean \
    .withColumn("rn", row_number().over(window_spec)) \
    .withColumn("has_default", spark_max(col("is_default").cast("int")).over(window_client)) \
    .withColumn(
        "is_default",
        when((col("has_default") == 0) & (col("rn") == 1), True)
        .otherwise(col("is_default"))
    ) \
    .drop("rn", "has_default")

# Vérification finale
total_clients = df_addresses_clean.select("customer_id").distinct().count()
clients_avec_defaut_final = df_addresses_clean.filter(col("is_default") == True) \
    .select("customer_id").distinct().count()

print(f"Total clients avec adresse: {total_clients}")
print(f"Clients avec défaut après correction: {clients_avec_defaut_final}")

print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication {df_promotions.count()}")
df_promotions_clean = df_promotions.dropDuplicates(["promotion_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication {df_promotions_clean.count()}")

#correction des dates
df_promotions_clean = df_promotions_clean.withColumn(
    "diff_days", 
    datediff(col("end_date"), col("start_date"))
)
df_promotions_clean = df_promotions_clean.withColumn("end_date",when(col("diff_days")<0,col("start_date")).otherwise(col("end_date")))
df_promotions_clean = df_promotions_clean.withColumn("start_date",when(col("diff_days")<0,col("end_date")).otherwise(col("start_date")))

print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication {df_shipments.count()}")

print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication {df_shipments_clean.count()}")
from pyspark.sql.functions import count, when ,col, trim, lower, length, concat, lit, lpad, substring, regexp_replace, to_date, least, greatest,dateadd,percentile_approx,datediff

#nettoyage des formats invalides des dates
df_shipments_clean = df_shipments_clean\
    .withColumn("delivery_date",regexp_replace(col("delivery_date"),"[/.]","-"))\
    .withColumn("delivery_date",
        when(col("delivery_date").rlike(r'^\d{8}'),

            substring(col("delivery_date"),5,2),lit("-"),
            substring(col("delivery_date"),7,2)
        )).otherwise(col("delivery_date")))\
    .withColumn("delivery_date",
        when(col("delivery_date").rlike(r'^\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}'),concat(
            substring(col("delivery_date"),-4,4),lit("-"),
            substring(col("delivery_date"),1,2),lit("-"),
            substring(col("delivery_date"),4,2))
        ).otherwise(col("delivery_date")))\
    .withColumn("delivery_date",to_date(col("delivery_date")))

#correction des dates invalides (swap des dates)
df_shipments_clean = df_shipments_clean.withColumn(
    "ship_date_new",
    when(
        col("ship_date").isNotNull() & col("delivery_date").isNotNull(),
        least(col("ship_date"), col("delivery_date"))
    ).otherwise(col("ship_date"))  
).withColumn(
    "delivery_date_new",
    when(
        col("ship_date").isNotNull() & col("delivery_date").isNotNull(),
        greatest(col("ship_date"), col("delivery_date"))
    ).otherwise(col("delivery_date"))  
).withColumn("ship_date", col("ship_date_new")) \
 .withColumn("delivery_date", col("delivery_date_new")) \
 .drop("ship_date_new", "delivery_date_new")

#Correction des coûts négatifs
from pyspark.sql.functions import abs
df_shipments_clean = df_shipments_clean.withColumn(
    "shipping_cost",when(col("shipping_cost")<0,abs(col("shipping_cost"))).otherwise(col("shipping_cost"))

print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication : {df_items.count()}")
df_items_clean = df_items.dropDuplicates(["order_item_id"])
print(f"nombre de lignes après déduplication : {df_items_clean.count()}")
from pyspark.sql.functions import count, col, when, percentile_approx,abs,coalesce

#Compléter les prix manquants

print(f"nombre de lignes avant déduplication: {df_returns.count()}")

).otherwise(col("return_reason")))

#Uniformisation des dates
df_returns_clean = df_returns_clean\
    .withColumn("return_date",regexp_replace(col("return_date"),"[./]","-"))\
    .withColumn("return_date",when(col("return_date").rlike(r'^\d{8}$'),

            substring(col("return_date"),1,4),lit("-"),
            substring(col("return_date"),5,2),lit("-"),
            substring(col("return_date"),7,2)
        )
    ).otherwise(col("return_date")))\
    .withColumn("return_date",when(col("return_date").rlike(r'^\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}$'),
        concat(
            substring(col("return_date"),-4,4),lit("-"),
            substring(col("return_date"),1,2),lit("-"),
            substring(col("return_date"),4,2)
        )
    ).otherwise(col("return_date")))\
    .withColumn("return_date",to_date(col("return_date")))

#fonction pour supprimer les doublons
def dedupliquer(df,pk,nom_table):
    avant = df.count()
    df_result = df.dropDuplicates([pk])
    apres = df_result.count()
    print(f"table [{nom_table}] déduplication ({pk}): {avant} -> {apres} ({avant - apres} doublons supprimés)")
    return df_result

#fonction pour compter les nulls
def compterNull(df,nom_table=""):
    print(f"Nulls pour {nom_table}\n")
    df.select([count(when(col(c).isNull(),c)).alias(c) for c in df.columns]).show()

#Générer toutes les dates entre 2020 et 2025
from pyspark.sql.functions import date_format,col,when,year,quarter,month,weekofyear,dayofmonth,dayofweek
df_date_range = spark.sql("""
    SELECT explode(sequence (to_date('2020-01-01'),to_date('2024-12-31'),interval 1 day)) as date
""")
#création de la dimension dim_date
dim_date = df_date_range\
    .withColumn("date_id", date_format(col("date"), "yyyyMMdd").cast("integer"))\
    .withColumn("year", year(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("quarter", quarter(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("month", month(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("month_name", date_format(col("date"), "MMMM"))\
    .withColumn("week", weekofyear(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("day", dayofmonth(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("day_name", date_format(col("date"), "EEEE"))\
    .withColumn("day_of_week", dayofweek(col("date")))\
    .withColumn("semester", when(col("month") <= 6, 1).otherwise(2))\
    .withColumn("is_weekend", when(col("day_of_week").isin(1, 7), True).otherwise(False))

print(f"Lignes générées : {dim_date.count()}")
